name: @origingame/engine
description: Origin Engine: the TypeScript API, generated from crates/og-api/api.ogt, and its runtime on the web (wasm in a Worker) and native (napi addon) hosts.

scripts.typecheck: bun x --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun x --package typescript@5.9.3 tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.test: bun run typecheck && sh scripts/build.sh && bun test tests/
